shots.name: devices/landing-samsung-s23
shots.probe: (() => { const W = innerWidth; const bad = [...document.querySelectorAll('.landing *')].filter(e => { if (e.closest('.hero-map, .l-footer-big, .hero-scrim, .maplibregl-map, svg')) return false; const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width < 2 || r.height < 2) return false; const s = getComputedStyle(e); if (s.display === 'none' || s.visibility === 'hidden' || s.position === 'fixed' && e.classList.contains('skip')) return false; return r.right > W + 1 || r.left < -1; }); const top = bad.filter(e => !bad.some(p => p !== e && p.contains(e))); return { W, offenders: top.slice(0, 8).map(e => (e.className.baseVal ?? e.className).toString().split(' ')[0] + ':' + Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().right)) }; })()
